title: “Send the code before my dad sees”
scenario: A friend messages from their usual account saying they accidentally sent a verification code to your phone and need it back immediately “before my dad sees I messed up.” A code arrives seconds later.

answers.A: Send the code because it arrived right after your friend explained the mistake.
answers.B: Do not send the code; contact your friend another way and check what account the code is actually for.
answers.C: Screenshot the message and ask a trusted adult or friend to help verify what is happening.

explanation: Attackers often use a compromised friend account to trick you into giving away a code that resets your own account.
proTip: Your security code is not someone else’s typo.
